direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just heard her father ask her to come home. His call interrupts her warm exchange with Kasun.
direction.people: Anudi stands frame left, facing right, in a cream blouse and muted teal skirt. She holds her phone to her right ear, an open umbrella in her left hand and her handbag on her left forearm. Her earlier warmth gives way to quiet concern.

flow.text: Anudi keeps her lips closed and her gaze lowered. Her faint smile gradually disappears, the corners of her mouth settling as her eyes drop further.

flow.how: Subdued and respectful, agreeing to come home with little emphasis, her gaze still lowered

flow.text: Her mouth closes and stays level. She keeps the phone at her ear.

direction.camera: A locked-off, eye-level close-up from the road side on a 65mm lens, with a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
